title: 한국농공학회논문집 2026년 제68권 1호
headline: 농촌진흥청 연구진이 2편으로 가장 활발했습니다.
bullets: 새로 등장한 키워드: ‘GRU’, ‘disaster mitigation’, ‘rain-shelter structure’, ‘wind pressure coefficient’, ‘Wind tunnel test’.
주로 쓰인 방법론: 딥러닝, 시계열(ARIMA 등), 현장 모니터링, LSTM/RNN.

papers.title: 평야부 용수계통을 고려한 농업용 저수지 이수안전도 평가
papers.title_en: Assessing Water Supply Reliability of Agricultural Reservoirs with Irrigation Canal Network Consideration

summary.result: Improving SWMM modeling accuracy and establishing standardized evaluation criteria will enhance future assessments and support more effective agricultural water resource management.
summary.background: W ater supply reliability is a key indicator of water resource stability; however, in the absence of standardized evaluation criteria, drought frequency has traditionally been used as a proxy to assess reservoir performance.
summary.method: Results were validated against the K-HAS model, a conventional water balance method widely used in Korea.

papers.title: 풍동 실험을 통한 개방형 비가림 농업시설의 풍압계수 산정 및 특성 분석
papers.title_en: Wind Pressure Coefficients of Open-Type Rain-Shelter Structures from Wind-Tunnel Experiments

summary.result: Future work will extend the scope of structures and wind conditions to provide a broader basis for standardizing wind-resistant design guidelines for open-type agricultural facilities.
summary.background: Ensuring the structural safety of agricultural facilities is increasingly important as extreme weather events intensify under climate change.
summary.method: Tests on single- and multi-span models evaluated roof-section responses and guided the proposal of design coefficients.

papers.title: 위성영상을 활용한 국외 곡물 작황 모니터링 웹 기반 시스템 설계 및 구축
papers.title_en: Design and Development of a Web-Based System for Monitoring Overseas Grain Crop Conditions Using Satellite Imagery

summary.result: Results are delivered through a web-based dashboard with intuitive visualization for users.
summary.background: Global food security is increasingly threatened by climate change, population growth, and market instability.
summary.method: Growth dynamics are assessed using time-series analysis of the NIRv index, enabling real-time comparison with long-term averages and the previous year.

papers.title: RNN, GRU, LSTM 모델을 이용한 낙동강 유역 잠재증발산량 예측 및 비교
papers.title_en: Prediction and Comparison of Potential Evapotranspiration Using RNN, GRU, and LSTM Models in the Nakdong River Basin

summary.result: The results consistently showed that LSTM and GRU models, which incorporate gate mechanisms, significantly outperformed the basic RNN model in prediction accuracy across all stations.
summary.background: We developed and compared three representative Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) models-basic RNN, Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM)-using daily meteorological data from 21 observation stations across the Nakdong River Basin in South Korea.
summary.method: The GRU model's performance was nearly equivalent to LSTM's, making it a computationally efficient alternative.

papers.title: 현장기반 모니터링을 통한 벼 재배기간 주요 영농작업별 대기질 변화특성 분석
papers.title_en: Field-based Monitoring of Air Quality Responses Associated with Agricultural Activities during Rice Cultivation

summary.result: Field leveling under flooded conditions did not significantly elevate PM concentration but produced a delayed NH 3 peak about 12-15 h later (peak 156.5 ppb), indicating post-flood volatilization.
summary.background: A fixed monitoring station was installed in a rice field in the Nonsan Plain, Korea, measuring PM-10, PM-2.5, NH 3 , NO 2 , and SO 2 at 5-min intervals.
summary.method: Event analysis was conducted by comparing pollutant concentrations before, during, and after each operation within ±24 h.

papers.title: 지하수이용 증가에 따른 한강유역의 수문학적 영향 평가
papers.title_en: Assessment of the Increased Groundwater Use on Watershed Hydrology in the Han River Basin

summary.result: Seasonal analysis indicated that TR notably decreased during autumn and winter, while BF showed a maximum reduction of 25.6% during summer season.
summary.background: SWAT was calibrated at 4 multi-purpose dams and 3 multi-functional weirs under 2010s weather and groundwater use conditions.
summary.method: The groundwater use data was established using groundwater survey yearbooks and applied to each subbasin using WUS tool of SWAT.
